# Beastry

> Index for https://beastry.app. The mother site is Chinese or English. This file lists stable links. It is not a copy of versions, open issues, or repository policy. A file inside a repository is authoritative. Checked 2026-11-23.

## Site

- [For agents](https://beastry.app/agents): website guidance for people and coding agents, in Chinese and English
- [Projects](https://beastry.app/projects): current product status
- [Take part](https://beastry.app/community): reads public GitHub ideas, labeled tasks, and merged pull requests. Submitting, +1, and comments happen on GitHub.
- [Help](https://beastry.app/help): bug and suggestion links for each product
- [About](https://beastry.app/about): mother brand
- [Home](https://beastry.app/)

On 2026-11-23, AGENTS.md was found only in Stow and MijiaBar. CONTRIBUTING.md was found only in Splatty. Octoshot, AgentKey, LetterBee, jiyi-mianbao, and beastry.app did not have either file.
